final: WITH patient_groups AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PLT) AS group_avg FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS overall_avg FROM patient_groups), differences AS (SELECT g.ID, g.SEX, g.group_avg, g.group_avg - o.overall_avg AS difference FROM patient_groups AS g JOIN overall AS o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(difference) AS sex_avg FROM differences GROUP BY SEX) SELECT AVG(d.group_avg), AVG(d.difference), AVG(d.difference - s.sex_avg) FROM differences AS d JOIN sex_averages AS s ON d.SEX = s.SEX WHERE d.difference > s.sex_avg
